name: freellmapi-chat-provider
description: Brings FreeLLMAPI's OpenAI-compatible free-model router into VS Code's native Chat model picker.

freellmapi.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the FreeLLMAPI OpenAI-compatible API, including the version path. Use the Docker/remote host when the gateway does not run on this machine.

freellmapi.autoDetectBaseUrl.description: When the configured base URL is on this machine but unreachable, look for a FreeLLMAPI gateway on the desktop app's port (31415 by default, read from its config.json) and on 3001, then use the one that answers. Remote base URLs are never probed.

freellmapi.modelCacheTtlMinutes.description: How long to cache the model catalog before refetching. 0 disables caching.

freellmapi.modelFilter.description: Optional comma-separated glob patterns matched against model ids and names (for example "auto*,claude*,gpt-*"). Empty shows every catalog model.

freellmapi.showUnavailableModels.description: List models the gateway cannot serve right now (no provider key, disabled, or quota exhausted). Off keeps the picker to usable models; turn it on to see and filter the full catalog.

freellmapi.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens requested per response. Clamped to the selected model's advertised context window.

enumDescriptions: Mark every model as accepting image input. FreeLLMAPI returns a clear error when no vision-capable model is available.
Mark only the auto/fusion router models as accepting image input.
Never advertise image input; image attachments are dropped before the request.
freellmapi.imageInput.description: How to advertise image input. The catalog does not publish per-model vision support.

freellmapi.debugLogging.description: Log raw HTTP requests and responses (credentials redacted) to the FreeLLMAPI output channel. Very verbose; enable only while troubleshooting.

freellmapi.statusBar.enabled.description: Show a FreeLLMAPI status bar item with server reachability and model availability.

freellmapi.healthCheckIntervalSeconds.description: How often to probe the FreeLLMAPI server for the status bar and model refresh.

freellmapi.server.autoStart.description: Start the FreeLLMAPI server automatically when the extension activates and the gateway is not already reachable.

freellmapi.server.path.description: Path to a FreeLLMAPI checkout or deployment used by "FreeLLMAPI: Start Server". Empty uses the first workspace folder.

freellmapi.server.startCommand.description: Explicit shell command that starts the FreeLLMAPI server (for example "npm run dev -w server" or "docker compose up -d"). It runs in the configured server path. Empty auto-detects a local checkout.

freellmapi.server.stopCommand.description: Explicit shell command that stops the FreeLLMAPI server (for example "docker compose down"). It runs before the extension terminates any server process it spawned itself.

freellmapi.server.startTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the server to answer after it is started.

scripts.release: npm run version:bump && npm run package
